title: Per-host bindings for refs in a shared include
summary: A ref inside an include that several units include keeps one binding per host (table ref_host_bindings, schema 26); find-callers and usages read it
intro: Read this when the same .inc is compiled into several units and a name in it means a different declaration in each. The resolver binds such a ref once per host and stores every host's target, so find-callers and usages list the site under each declaration instead of leaving it name-only.
